annotations.title: TIA — compare a block with given SimaticML

description: Exports the block from the project and compares it with the SimaticML you pass (e.g. the file committed in git). Like tia_export_block, this may compile an inconsistent block first (export requires consistency), which can regenerate its instance DB; read-mostly, treated as read for agent tool policy. Normalized: ignores BOM, line endings, indentation, blank lines, <Created>, <InstalledProducts>, UId attributes and — unless ignoreFormatting:false — <NewLine/>/<Blank/> formatting tokens (see the result's `ignored` field for the exact list). Returns verdict equal|different and the first differing line. This is the proof that the project contains what was versioned. Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/blocks/{block}/xml. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

options.description: ExportOptions used for the project side (default None)

xml.description: SimaticML XML to compare against (e.g. the committed file's content)
